- memory_id "1000177" [constraint]: The job scheduler deploys only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000292" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000161" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000231" [decision]: Yuki Tanaka is on call for the Cinder team this cycle, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000219" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000258" [decision]: Lena takes the pager rotation for the Boreal team as of 2025-03-17, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000167": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
